Its keywords include cezallier, open-data, donnees-ouvertes, valeur-ecologique, contrat-territorial, tourbieres. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
